DO NOT BRING YOUR PETS HERE!!!!!!!!!!
I brought my cat in twice in the space of 1 week back in July, she was vomiting her own poo, shedding in clumps, overall not herself and her symptoms were essentially ignored, I was told it was just the heat during the summer and to just keep her cool. She ended up in emergency services 2 days after her last visit to this place, I called back saying my cat needed imaging done ASAP they gave me an appointment a week out (after having a referral from emergency services saying she needed this ASAP). After this I gave up, the level of care is shocking, I took her to My Vet in Lucan which I can't recommend enough - they actually took the concerns, evaluated her and gave her all the treatements she needed which Castle Vets actively failed to provide even after 2 visits, I was charged on both instances to be told my pet was fine when she evidently wasn't. After reading further reviews I noticed that in July this place had a pattern to killing animals (which is when I brought my cat in). DO NOT BRING YOUR PETS HERE.
Great after care best veterinary care

I recently had my Yorkshire Terrier in for his booster and the staff are very friendly and helpful. We have the Petplan which covers boosters, flea/tick and worming tablets. So I pay a small amount a month and don't have to worry about upcoming expenses. I always walk to Castle Veterinary Clinic, but there are a couple of parking spaces out front if that is not possible. There is also a separate waiting area for Cats. I would definitely recommend this vets over others, I have never heard a bad word about them.

Castle Vets is the best veterinary clinic I have ever been to. I brought my rabbit (Roger) there and from the moment we arrived, I knew he was in the best hands. Stephen is an exceptionally knowledgeable veterinarian who genuinely cares about every animal that comes into the clinic, and that dedication is evident in the outstanding care he provides. It’s clear that the animals always come first. The receptionists are also incredibly welcoming, friendly, and helpful, making every visit a positive experience. I couldn’t recommend Castle Vets highly enough.

They never waited the recommended 2 weeks before administering the 2nd dose for the annual vaccination which resulted in the death of our cat which raises serious concerns in terms of how many other people lost a pet because the vet never followed the drug manufacturers guidelines. By administering another dose of the vaccine within a 9 day period on the instructions of the vet, this created a toxic build up which caused kidney failure to a previously healthy cat. Our cat was in perfect health prior to this. I'd stay well away from this shack of an establishment if you value your pet. Unfortunately what you see is often what you get and judging by the inside and outside of the premises, this place is dirtier than a stable. The people and pets of Clondalkin deserve better than this. Life is too short to take chances when it comes to proper health care even for pets. Walk into the reception in My Vets in Lucan and judge the difference in cleanliness for yourself. I would highly recommend My Vets in Lucan for a high quality professional 5 star service.

After moving to Ireland from South Africa with my two fur babies, they’ve been incredible from day one — even going out of their way to get my cat’s full medical history from our vet back home as she was born with only one kidney so had special needs. When it came time to say goodbye after 11 years, they showed so much compassion and care, giving us the time and support we needed. I can’t thank Castle Vets enough for the incredible care they gave to my beloved Milo over the years. For the past nine years, they have always looked after him so well, even though he wasn’t always the easiest patient! I am forever grateful for everything they did for him, especially during his final week. The team worked tirelessly to get to the bottom of what was going on and, although we couldn’t save him, I truly believe they did absolutely everything they could.

The compassion and understanding shown by everyone at Castle during such a difficult time meant so much to us. After Milo’s passing, we were deeply touched to receive a beautiful card, along with vials of his hair, his paw prints, and some forget-me-not seeds. This thoughtful gesture left us completely moved.

Castle Vets have been amazing throughout Milo’s life, and I will always appreciate the kindness, professionalism, and care they gave him from start to finish, thanks again guys 💖
